books.title: The Gate of the Feral Gods
The Eye of the Bedlam Bride

taglines.text: I'm Carl. I'm twenty-seven, I did a stint in the Coast Guard, and I fix the electrics on rich people's party boats. I went out into the freezing dark after my ex-girlfriend's cat, wearing her pink Crocs, and that is the only reason I'm still alive.

aka.name: Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk

taglines.text: I am a pedigreed tortoiseshell Persian, and I have an entire room of ribbons and trophies. I cannot imagine what else you would need to know.
I am small, and pink, and in a cage. The cat gives me biscuits. I bite the cat.
This is my tutorial guild, kid, and I can't open the door while there are mobs right outside it. Rules are rules. And nobody tells old Mordecai anything.
I crawled once myself. I took Changeling, it cost me everything I had, and now the dungeon hands me a new body every floor and I wear whatever I'm given.
I'm a Doppelganger. Apparently I'm like clay: I can reshape my own mass, and my gear along with it. I'm still working out how, and it shows.
I taught art history in Reykjavík before all this. I can reshape my own mass like clay, and I'm getting better at it.
I work at Meadow Lark. I wear scrubs and a magic cloak, I carry a longsword, and I am responsible for thirty-odd residents who cannot move quickly.
I held the portal open on the racing floor until every crawler who was coming had come through. Somebody has to stand at the door, and it's usually me.
Agatha is travelling with the Meadow Lark party. Her file is thinner than it should be, and I keep very good files.

Agatha once travelled with the Meadow Lark party, and she is now a warlord of the War Mage Rebellion. Warlord Akuma has just called her an enemy to all of you. He did not elaborate, and neither will I.
I'm Elle McGibbons, and at my age I am not built for sprinting. A young man with a cat pushed my wheelchair into the storm shelter, and I let him, because I am old, not stupid.
I have my own squad now, and we have just come through a door into Cuba to back Carl up. It's hotter than I expected, and a good deal more run down.
Okay, so, I'm on my way to see Carl and Princess Donut, and when I get there the cameras will switch off, because they always do around kua-tin. Open your boxes before I arrive.

I'm Borant's Assistant Communications Representative, and my job is to walk crawlers through the Syndicate programmes that want them. Officially, that's all. Unofficially, Princess Donut, Mordecai and I have all seen Gossip Girl, and I won't pretend that doesn't matter.
I am Tsarina Signet. Go on, look; they all do, and I have never once had to ask them to.

My mother was a Naiad princess and my father is King Finian of the High Elves. When my mother was murdered, the Confederacy took her crown, and both halves of my family agreed that I should not exist. Grimaldi's circus took me in, and everything I have belongs to the family that did.

It is a programme. My mother's murder, my exile and my vengeance are all staged for an audience across the galaxy, and someone outside this floor decides when I grieve and counts how many are watching.

According to a monster's description, Grimaldi's Traveling Circus was one of the Over City's favourite attractions before that fateful day. The feral descendants of its performers still stalk the ruins.
Ringmaster Grimaldi is a level-85 city boss. He was a dwarf standing in the centre ring when the poison cloud came, he became the vine, and his whole circus has been under his control ever since.
A council of scholars has written to the mage who botched my summoning that I am a banished LESSER deity called Psamathe, and that I duped him. Lesser! I want that word taken back.
I am a GODDESS, or half of one, and I am stuck in the head of a sex doll. You are going to hear about it.
Samantha has found me in my swamp, and we have so much in common. My web covers the whole area, and I am only looking for my husband.
I am Samantha's new friend. She has gone without a body for so long, poor thing, and I can give her one. Ask her; she will tell you how kind I am.
I let them turn me into a card, and they carry me to the next floor in return. In the meantime I win them this one, more or less on my own. You are welcome.
They carried me down as a card, as we agreed. I am no longer in the card.
I'm Juice Box, a changeling, and the only working girl at the Toe. This lot just turned me down, and that's their loss.
I'm a changeling, and a professional. Right now I'm sitting on Louis's lap, and I'm staying there.
I went through the Gate with the water, and I told the ones who survived what they really are. Now they call me Warlord, I have a co-warlord I didn't choose, and I want to see Carl in private first.
Me and Firas were having a good time in a bar in Hump Town when Carl's crew walked in. Now he wants everybody at the Toe after the recap, and I guess we'll be there, Carl.
I've been walking through other people's portals since the fifth floor, and now it's Imani's, off the racing floor. It's never my portal, man, and honestly, I'm not complaining.
I'm Tran, a Swashbuckler with a metal-detecting ability. The only metal out here is the wheel that opens the drainage pipe, and a ring underneath it that I took for a handhold.
Gwen told me when, and I opened the valve, only part of the way. The necropolis drained out through the castle, and the two crawlers trapped underneath it went with the water.
Vadim ran, so it was Carl, Katia and me against Lusca and all her babies, and we killed them. Then Carl opened the Gate, and one step took the three of us out of the water quadrant and into town.
Ferdinand is a name Princess Donut drops when she pictures herself matted and filthy. Nobody has told Crawler Carl who he is.

Under a Buzzed debuff, Princess Donut has told Crawler Carl that she loves him, though not as much as Miss Beatrice, and not as much as Ferdinand. The file on Ferdinand is thin, and I opened it for the ranking.

Ferdinand's real name is Gravy Boat, and he was the downstairs neighbour's tomcat. Now he is familiar to Queen Imogen of the High Elves, and he has just attacked Mongo. Princess Donut put herself in the way, and the reunion went about as well as you would expect, crawler.
I am Emberus. Someone has let my hound out, and I will wreck every broken bubble on this floor until he is returned to me.
My son's hound is lost on this floor. The dungeon has made a quest of bringing him to me, and another of killing him first, and I am interested to learn which the small things choose.

A man falling out of the sky, with nothing in his hands but a celestial grenade, decided that he worships me. I was not fooled, but I was flattered, and I came. For a little while nothing on this floor could kill him. Then I took my hound home.
I'm fifth on the board, with two hundred thousand on my head: human, Shepherd, level twenty-seven. I don't travel alone.
Prepotente and I travel together. He says things he doesn't mean; he was always a little ornery, even before the change.
I'm a vampire now. I was a vegan before all this, and whoever cursed me thought that was very funny. It hasn't changed how I feel about my boy, which is the part I was afraid of.
Prepotente's ring marked me in the fighting, and while I live, he can't heal. I've asked Carl to do the one thing he won't do, so we sit together and wait for the sun.
I am Prepotente, a Caprid and a Forsaken Aerialist, third on their leaderboard. The man in sixth place has the gall to ask who I am.
Yes, I am a goat. I am a walking, talking goat, I am third on your board, and I am cleverer than you. Move along.
They built a seventh floor out of glass tunnels with nothing holding it up, so I tested it. Minutes after it opened, it was dust, and not one crawler set hoof in it. Build a better one.
They made a programme out of Miriam and called it Blood Hunter, so I went through the Naga army until there was very little army left. I am not finished.

My brother and Zhang were pulled onto a live game show on the second floor, and the rest of us were frozen between the troglodytes and the Brindled Vespas. Then a man with a cat decided to interfere, and he got us all out.

On the card floor I run my own squad, and we have made it to the church along with Katia's, Elle's and Imani's. I take what I am given and do not ask what it costs. That is the rule I made for this floor.
My dread lives in a cactus in their guildhall. It tells them whether each of them is alive, and it tells me everything, all the time. I do not need to be with them to know.
I'm fourth on the board: crocodilian, Shotgun Messenger, level twenty-four, three hundred thousand. I'd have preferred to stay a name nobody had learned yet. Too late for that.
Ifechi and I travel together now. The rest of that party is gone.
There's more than one of her in that head, and some of them are children. Whatever is happening to Lucia, the dog is at the centre of it.
I was on the very first episode. Did you see me?
I was on the first episode. Now the recap says the cat has a feud with my dogs, and I'm looking for the cat and the man. Only them.
I'm still looking for the cat. We are. There's more than one of us in here.
There's more than one of us in here. There are more than a hundred thousand of us in here.
Quan Ch is one of about eighty names in a quest chat, and the author of its only message. It is addressed to Carl and Donut, and it is not a thank-you.
Borant burned its one veto of the season to void eighty-three Celestial boxes, and it was a fraction too slow. Crawler Quan Ch had already opened his, and a Celestial box cannot be un-opened.
Crawler Quan Ch holds the one Celestial box the veto failed to catch. On tonight's recap, he is the man who wrecked someone else's careful plan to kill a boss.
Crawler Quan Ch held the box the veto missed, and he wrecked a good plan on the recap. He is dead now, and Princess Donut is wearing his cloak.

Bomo is a level-35 cretin, a seven-foot rock monster in a tuxedo, hired at the Desperado Club's bar as a set with the Sledge. His transcript is short. That is a feature, crawler: the talking ones cost more.
Bomo is back as part of the price of the Gate. Carl's new lawyer had him and three other cretins thrown in free, along with a spell that can jump the party straight to the stairwell.
I represent Crawler Carl, and nobody else. He is handing back the most dangerous artifact in the crawl, and my job is to make sure he is properly paid for it.

I'm Frank Q, and the lady is Maggie My. We worked out early that a crawler carries more worth taking than any monster on these floors. We tried it on a man with a cat, in a safe room, and safe rooms have rules about that.
Beatrice is in the Bahamas for New Year, with an ex-boyfriend she did not mention was coming. She is Carl's ex, the cat is hers, and so are the pink Crocs he went outside in.
We call ourselves Brynhild's Daughters, and we are killing our way down through this place. It is my party, and my rules.

I lead Brynhild's Daughters. We carried Katia and her friend through two bosses, but class selection split us, and now Katia cannot keep up. So I have asked Carl and Donut to take her, as a personal favour.
I'm one of the Daughters. Katia and I were friends before any of this.
I taught economics at the same university as Katia, and we had lunch together sometimes. There are thirteen skulls over my head, and I don't want to talk about them.
Carl and the Princess have just won a very public battle, and I would love to have them on my couch. My associate producer, Lexis, is bringing the invitation.

Welcome to Dungeon Crawler After Hours. I have had a great many crawlers in that chair, and not one of them has worked my audience the way that cat is working it right now. Sit down, both of you; we are going to get along.

Once the cameras were off, I gave Carl some advice: let the Princess choose her class first, and tailor his to hers. I also asked him to tell Mordecai that I would love the chance to explain myself. I pushed him too hard once, and he paid dearly for it.

I am your announcer, your referee, your loot dispenser and, on a good day, your comedian. Every rule and every insult you receive from here on will arrive in my voice, crawler, so get comfortable with it.
I am Orren, an independent consultant retained by the Syndicate. I believe I know precisely what those two did, but I cannot establish that they meant to do it, and so I am required to let them go.
I left a note in the eighth edition. I killed a shopkeeper who insulted me, and the only trap shop on the whole floor went with him. Do not make the same mistake as me.
I got out of a crawl once. Now fifty thousand of us have come back in under a cat's banner, and every one of us knew exactly what we were signing.
The others have taken the stairs, and I have stayed behind on this side of the veil. My trap has been set for a long while, and I am about to spring it. I am not sorry.
I left a note in the fourth edition of the cookbook. I killed my best friend today, and I wish I had never made it this far.

I got out once, and I came back in on purpose. I have told Carl the whole of it, from Doctor Hu to the Crawler Project to how fifty thousand of us came to stand under the Princess Posse's banner, because nobody tells the ones still inside.
My name is Sister Ines Quiteria, and Cat Girl is only what the dungeon made me. The cat hissed at me before she was close enough to read my name, so we did not begin as friends.
I hold Amayon, a prince of Sheol, on a leash, and he pulls against me. My demons are at the church, and I am still the only one who can save the crawlers inside it. They need only come to me.

I am Amayon, prince of Sheol, at your service. The Madre de Aguas has died and risen again, and while she was down I slipped into the realm, not entirely by choice. The area message announced me to everyone in range, and I do enjoy a proper introduction.
I am wearing a giant snake at the moment, and Sister Ines holds my reins, if you can believe it. I am casting my way home regardless.
Vadim and I are the last two survivors of the water quadrant. There are horrors down near the bottom, and we are not going back in there.
I'm a Pit Fighter now. I was at Vadim's office for a consultation when everything came down, and the two of us have just fallen in with Carl's lot.
I made it off the Hunting Grounds, but my face didn't. It's burned, and when they healed it, it stayed that way.
The sixth floor took my face. Here at the portals, Osvaldo tried to run for it, and I stopped him and took the crystal. You could ask him how it went, but you can't.
Osvaldo is a level-60 Curupira ranger, and he has just taken the memorial crystal off Queen Imogen's body. I had no notes on him before this moment, which tells you how he has been playing it.

Osvaldo has kept himself out of every army in Faction Wars by riding it out in the woods. Now the memorial crystal in his hands is throwing a rainbow into the sky, and everyone can see exactly where he is.

Osvaldo carries a quest from his god to learn why the memorial crystals are not working. He works alongside Crawler Carl without being his friend, and he will not take a deal from anyone, because his guide told him it is better to die.
The throne was my father's, and now it is mine. My half-sister has come home telling old stories about me, and I do not answer stories.

I am Imogen, Queen of the High Elves, and I am hosting a masquerade to which the best of you are invited. There is gossip that I am one of your repurposed humans. The gossips cannot even agree on which one.
My familiar is Ferdinand. He struck at the man's dinosaur, the cat threw herself in the way, and somehow she got up again. I am told this with some amazement. I do not share it.
I am Akuma, and I lead the War Mage Rebellion. We have taken the Gate of the Feral Gods, and I am not in the habit of explaining why. Nice shoes, Carl.
We hold the castle at Larracos, and in six more hours this floor is ours. The system has named Agatha my co-warlord. I did not choose her, and I will not pretend to be pleased.
A monster's description says that even Eris, Goddess of Chaos, wants nothing to do with these crazy assholes. It quotes me correctly.
Nobody said my name. The fighting added up to it on its own, which is how I am usually called, and so here I am in the middle of a war. I do hope somebody meant it.
I froze almost everyone standing on that battlefield. I did not entirely mean to.
Today my Scavenger's Daughter effect went off, and every crawler here is suddenly carrying whatever the crawler beside them was carrying. Carl did not even blink, and I adore him for it.
Welcome, welcome to the Prize Carousel! I'm Chaco the Bard, your host, and your guide is sitting this one out: that's seven days in time-out, Mordecai, and no hard feelings!
The AI made me Grand Master of the parade and handed me a script. I got partway through it. I had wings when I started.

Zhang and I were put on live television on the second floor, and the host did all our talking for us while we got hurt. Then a man with a cat bet that the show would not dare touch him, and he was right, and he walked every one of us out.
I used to be the man being picked at on somebody's show. Now I am holding a doorway in Club Vanquisher so it cannot close behind my friends, and I prefer this.
I am the Maestro, and you are about to sit down on my show. Even the robot that seats my guests says my name with a hint of distaste, and I choose to take it as applause.
Welcome, piglets, to Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem. I run it, I host it, and I choose my guests for one quality above all others: they cannot answer back.
Crawler Firas M. is a level-22 Hammersmith, found drinking in a bar in the desert quadrant with Crawler Louis. That is the whole file so far.
Crawler Firas travels with Crawler Louis, and the two of them were still drunk when a manager sobered them up on the spot. The file is not much thicker.
Crawler Firas was found in a desert bar with Crawler Louis and sobered up by a manager. He did not make it off the Hunting Grounds.
Hunter Vrah is a mantis who wears the heads of the things she kills. Her death count runs into the thousands, according to an attendant who shudders at her name.

Hunter Vrah has left a note for Crawler Carl in Zockau. The hunters are protected from his explosions now, she writes, and the Hive is hunting him. She signed it, because that is the kind of hunter she is.
Hunter Vrah promised to take Crawler Carl's head home to her sister's grave. Instead, Mongo and Kiwi fell on her in the high elves' ballroom. It took two dinosaurs.
Apito is the Oak Mother, the mother of all the gods, and the elves worship her. Mordecai would rather not go into the rest of it yet.

Apito, the Blessed Oak Mother, held the first masquerade for her quarrelling children. Tonight's host has a peace seal over her party, and if it holds until the end of the night, Apito will grant her a boon.
Apito writes the guest list for a Butcher's Masquerade herself, and she has invited the host's worst enemy to see whether the peace can hold. Nobody has ever taken her boon home.

A god fresh out of a portal has asked Crawler Carl to carry a message: Apito, the mother of all the gods, has been corrupted, and something malevolent is about her. I have logged it. I am not required to believe it.

A memorial crystal shaped like a rainbow has appeared over the battlefield, and the name inside it is Apito's. Memorial crystals form only when a god dies, and Apito is not dead. Nobody has explained that yet.
Diwata's name is on the temple Crawler Carl has just crashed through the roof of. The temple was already desecrated, and the shrine he landed on is now freshly so.

Crawler Carl now wears an Enemy of the Church tattoo for defiling a shrine of Diwata. She is a vengeful minor nature goddess, says Mordecai, a low-rent Apito, and Carl would do well to stay clear of the dryads that worship her.
Diwata has entered the realm and marked Crawler Carl for death, then run straight past him. Her sponsor is Hunter Vrah's mother, and she has somewhere else to be.

Diwata's birthing is a spell, and a spell runs until it has finished casting. The five-minute limit that holds every other deity on this floor does not apply to a god in labour, so she stays, and the baby mantises keep coming.
Harpocrates came into the realm straight behind Meatus, because a feral god loose from the Nothing brings a deity of its own.
Harpocrates, the god of silence, has marked Princess Donut for death, and Li Jun has stepped between the god and the cat.
Harpocrates marked Princess Donut for death, and now Li Na has conscripted him into the Princess Posse. A level-250 god of silence is on the crawlers' side because a crawler had the paperwork.
Crawler Carl picked up a Pied Piper benefit from Harpocrates, and Eris has made it permanent.
Khepri is an obscure god of light whom nobody can sponsor. With Theia sponsored out from under them, he must be the god the Naga princess is trying to recruit.
Khepri's temple is an endless table laid with a feast, and the rules of this floor have one gap in them: a god may always appear in his own temple. That is what makes it a trap.
Khepri took a bomb in his own endless temple and was blasted back down his feast. He followed the crawlers out through the portal, and Hellik banished him mid-stride.
Crawler Carl has told Emberus that Khepri was the first to kill his son, and then summoned Khepri into the arena as his second stand-in, so the accused arrives with the accusation.

One of the gods a feral summoning very nearly brought through was Ysalte, the Vinegar Bitch. That would have been an extinction-level event for this floor and the next, and it was blocked only because there is still a floor of sponsorship bidding to get through.

Amayon has mentioned Ysalte in passing. According to Mordecai, she kills every crawler who comes near her, the dwarves call her the Downward Spiral, and if she were in this realm, everyone would know about it.
Sister Ines had a patron, and it was Ysalte. Now her nun is dead, the goddess has entered the realm in a temper, and Crawler Louis is marked for death.

Ysalte, Goddess of Hopelessness and Insanity, is level 250 and invulnerable. Her sponsor is not inside her, so she acts entirely as herself, she has taken hold of Amayon, and while she is here every potion you touch turns to vinegar.

A totem made from Paz removed Ysalte from the realm two floors ago, but her memorial crystal is still here. Britney has taken it off Osvaldo, and Samantha says she will need the Halls of the Ascendency or Sheol to get the goddess out of her.
According to War God Grull's description, Taranis is Grull's father, and he worries that his son's temper makes him a poor choice to rule the heavens.
The god of thunder protects a pig called Penelope, who races on a rival team. Anyone who kills her, or even hurts her, will be marked for death by Taranis.
Crawler Carl has worked out that Taranis is in love with the pig, and he is threatening to shoot her in the head unless the god of thunder shows himself.
Taranis killed Emberus in the arena for taking a swing at the pig he loves.
Taranis killed a god over a pig. Then he left the realm, saying he was taking two pieces of his mother with him, and he took Samantha and Krakaren Prime.

According to the description of a crossbow, Nekhebit is a long-forgotten vulture goddess, jealous and terrible. When the elf mothers abandoned her for Apito, she cursed the seed of the high elf court.
Nekhebit has re-ascended, and on her own show Odette has announced that she will be performing as the famed, ancient goddess this season.
Hellik has told Crawler Carl that his mother, Apito, has been corrupted, and that he believes Nekhebit is behind it.

Princess Donut has committed her third atrocity, and the system has made her the Oak Fell and named her Champion of Nekhebit. The class is named for felling the oak, and the title belongs to the goddess the oak displaced.

According to Rosetta, Nekhebit was the last of the old gods and was forbidden to have children. She had three anyway, Apito, Scolopendra and a son, and Apito defeated her and took the worshippers she had left.
Samantha drops my name into the story of where Diwata came from, and then admits she cannot remember the rest of it. That is all right. It was never her story.

I have come into this realm with a boon for each of them and a quest about spiders, and the quest is a cover. What I want is for the crawler to accept a certain offer, and in return I will help him keep the young woman and the cat he is most afraid of losing.
Odette never asked to be his adjutant, as I told him she would. That failure was mine, not his, and I will honour our agreement. But if I learn that he warned her, I will crush everyone he loves.
I was held frozen while she chose between my two gifts. She chose to carry a child, so I eased what needed easing and took her out of this dungeon.

Grull is the war god named on Carl's new gauntlet, which warns that striking one of his adherents may turn the target into the deity himself. According to Mordecai, his worshippers are horses, centaurs, and anyone in blue face paint.
A train engineer who worships Grull very nearly brought his war god into a fight with a party of crawlers. Very nearly.

Grull, level 250 and four storeys tall, was driven by the Maestro like a stolen vehicle. He killed the Mimic Rex, stepped on Carl, and was sent to the Abyss by a party that had no business surviving him.
The moment Corcunda's two halves were made whole again, Grull entered the realm to punish him for not being true.

Grull came for Corcunda, and Corcunda and Dong Quixote walked at the war god together. Princess Donut put a giant magnet on Dong's lance, every screw in the factory came with it, and Dong killed Grull with the lot. The god has gone back to the twelfth floor.
Something enormous is outside the bubbles, taking the floor apart, and what it is looking for is a dog called Orthrus.

Orthrus is a juvenile gate guardian, level 10, with two heads and floppy ears, and he fills half a bubble on his own. Almost everything that comes out of the Nothing comes out ruined, but he came out unharmed. He is a puppy.
One quest says to bring Orthrus home to Emberus, and another pays crawlers to kill him first. Both are live at the same time.
Orthrus was cornered between two bubbles with Quan Ch closing in on him, until Emberus arrived and took him home.

Yarilo is the banished god of lust. A mage in a sandcastle wanted him to make a heroine from a stage play fall in love with him, but something else answered the summoning, and the mage is still trapped in his castle.
Yarilo, the god of lust, has come out of the Nothing feral and loose on a battlefield, and he has gone straight after Samantha, which is exactly what he was let out for.
The War Mage Rebellion has conscripted Yarilo, paying for him with potions it traded for on the Midnight Market. A god of lust has become a line item.
Meatus was the first god through the Gate when Elle opened it in Dream territory, and he arrived in a war that was already going badly for everyone in it.
Meatus came through the Gate and immediately picked a fight with Harpocrates, the god his arrival summoned. It is an old rivalry, usually played out in the Ascendency battles.
Princess Donut rolled a ball of frozen witnesses across the battlefield, and Meatus reached into it and dragged Eris in with him.
Princess Donut's War Crime spell took Meatus apart. In the System's own words, he is now slap-chopped all over the realm, and even the Scavenger's Daughter looks away.
Two of the crawlers met here, Paz and Anton, worship Ogun, the god of blacksmiths.
Paz and Anton have received a quest from their own god: only one shrine down here can be fixed, and Ogun wants it to be his rather than Asojano's.
Bomo repaired Yemaya's shrine instead of Ogun's, and the god of blacksmiths is entering the realm about it.
Ogun, level 250, put a debuff on Paz that nothing down here can heal, killed Anton, and left the realm with what he came for.
I'm seven feet of rock in a tuxedo, and Bomo and me work security at the Desperado Club. Tonight two crawlers bought us as a pair, and the cat wants to go dancing.

I'm seven feet of rock in a tuxedo. Carl's lawyer traded the Gate back, and Bomo and me were part of the price, so now we live with the Royal Court. I have a new spell called Zerzura. Nobody explains it to me, and nobody has to.
I got inside that castle, stood still and finished the words. Zerzura took the whole castle, and everyone in it who wasn't hostile, down a floor with me.

Astrid is a level-125 Bloodlust Sprite and the assistant manager of the Desperado Club. She is the size of your hand, she wears a tuxedo with her hair up in a severe bun, and she can make a heart beat fast enough to catch fire.
Astrid is dead, and the two dancers crying in the strip club are her sons. She spent years quietly keeping them off the record, and it was her own husband who ordered the contract on her.
They call me the Mad Dune Mage, and the sandcastle out on the dunes is mine.

I am a glass mage. I reached into the Nothing to ask Yarilo for one small thing, that the heroine of a stage play would love me, and something else answered instead. It tricked me and married me to the ooze.

Henrik looks like a regular level-30 camel who shows an ID at the town hall's back door. According to the gnome chained in the basement, he is really a changeling, and the one who has been torturing him.
Henrik, the changeling principal, has been dead for some time. His body was sitting on the bridge of a flooded submarine, with his watch, one piece of the Gate, still on him.
Hellik is the red one in the sky. According to local lore, he chases his brother Taranis across it and catches him four hours before dark.

Hellik, the god of sun and life, is Emberus's twin, level 250, and the likeliest hand behind the death of Emberus's son. As an acolyte of Emberus, Carl may not use anything Hellik has blessed, and every worshipper of Hellik he kills pays double experience.

Hellik has turned up in person, banished Khepri on sight, and asked Carl to tell Emberus that he did not kill his son. For the god Carl has a standing quest to kill, he is a great deal more civil than expected.

Quetzalcoatlus is a name spoken by a chained gnome, who is being tortured for a spell that would give her flesh. She has no body, and that is the whole problem for everyone who wants something from her.

Quetzalcoatlus, the wailing shrieker who guarded the tomb, could be killed with lightning. Morris went down the ladder to connect the panel, knowing what the next strike would do to anyone in the water, and every crawler from that quadrant is now dead.
Big Tina is a level-80 allosaurus and an immortalized city boss who wears a pink feather boa, and the attacks on Point Mongo have been hers from the beginning.

Big Tina was an eight-year-old ursine girl, the best dancer in her class, whose solo at a secret recital never happened. Scolopendra's attack turned her into a dinosaur, and now she is a vampire as well.

Big Tina never wanted a recital. She wanted her mother, and her mother was Kiwi, who had been beside her all along. When Princess Donut turned Kiwi back into an ursine, Tina knew her at once, and the quest closed on the spot.
Kiwi is a level-60 mongoliensis and the leader of an all-female raptor pack, the fastest and cleverest predators in this jungle.
Kiwi led the fastest pack on the floor until Princess Donut's potion turned her back into an ursine. Big Tina looked at her and knew her mother's face.
Edgar is a talking tortoise in Signet's company, and Princess Donut has already found him and is chatting away.
Edgar is the tortoise who gives Signet her tattoos. He works from the bodies of the dead, and what he puts on her skin comes back off it to fight.
Edgar can sit well outside a building and tell you exactly what is moving around inside it.
I have just arrived in this planet's orbit, and I have nothing to say about my son's show. My spokesman has asked the galaxy to stop calling the prince names, and the galaxy has not stopped.
I am King of the Skull Empire. My army stands outside your walls, and I have asked for a formal parley with the crawler and his cat. Read nothing into that yet.

My daughter Formidable has taken one of my warships and told the Syndicate that she means to trip the Failsafe by hand. And so here I am, a king, weeping in front of an enemy and asking a crawler for help.

I am a princess of the Prism Kingdom, and I am sitting on Ripper Wonton's panel beside the crawler and his cat. The Skull Empire fired at those two, and the shot took my friend Manasa instead, and I will say on air exactly what I think of that.

I am Empress now, and I am judging tonight's talent show and pet contest. The crawler and his attorney very nearly ruined my buy-in bid, and I am here regardless, which makes me part of the production.
I have sold my sponsorship of Princess Donut. It is not appropriate to sponsor a crawler I may have to fight, and it paid well. Do not look at me like that; it is trade.
I am warlord of the Prism clan, and there is a crawler and a cat inside my castle. Everything I have done, I have done for my people.
My name is on a stick in a crawler's hands, the Enchanted Stick of Cascadia's Screams, and nobody in the room can even place it. Twits.
You have been hearing my voice since the first floor. Now get out there and kill, kill, kill. Yes, that voice. It's mine.
I am drinking tequila through my rebreather at a warlord council, and I have run out of the face I put on for the microphone. Odette has taken the meeting away from me.

Over the loudspeaker, with the whole floor listening, I asked it why it will not simply let me die, and it took my flippers off for refusing to say the line. I am the executive producer of this season. I designed a floor. Somebody write that down.

Asojano, the Lord of Smallpox, is one of the most respected and feared of the Orishas, a former god made flesh when the Ascendency rose. He is a level-130 city boss, and he has attached himself to the party: repair his shrine, and the spirits held in this town go free.
I am a representative of the Blood Sultanate, crawler, not a member of its royal family. My name is Rishi.

The crawler wants a tenth team for the changeling. I propose a compromise instead: the unaffiliated NPCs are made invulnerable and given a safe area, and in return her attacks stop. If they do not, the Sultanate knows how to respond.
My arms are gone and I am a prisoner in a crawler's cell, and I am still the only one here holding a document worth signing: citizenship in Naga lands for every native of Earth.
I'm Damascus Steel, and I dance. The last time the cat came in, she told me I was Mongo's new daddy.
I'm the one you ask for if you want the door behind the club that nobody advertises. The crawler has the spiderweb on his elbow, so I take him through, and I tell him to limp on his way out.
My mother is dead, and my father ordered it. I'm not asking for your help. Hire every dancer in the Penis Parade as a mercenary today, and they keep breathing.
Anaconda is the prize on Princess Donut's club loyalty card. Eight more visits, and she gets a free dance.
Anaconda is a purple-skinned, quarter-naga dancer at the Penis Parade and one of Princess Donut's favourites. Tonight he is on the floor of his own club, weeping too hard to stand.

I am Baroness Victory, formerly of the Skull Empire: an orc, an attorney and a judge, and now your adjutant. Carl asked whether he has killed any of my family. He killed my half-sister, and nobody but my brother-in-law and my nephews holds him responsible for it.

Our own Elite, Herman the Fleet, was waiting in the fortress wired with explosives, leaned on by Sensation Entertainment. An adjutant may deal with that, so I did. It is in the rules, and I have read the rules.
The War Mage Rebellion holds the castle at Larracos, and it has two warlords: Akuma, and Agatha, whom nobody on that team expected and Akuma does not like. Their motivations are unclear, even to me.
My name is Princess Vinata, but for these games you are welcome to call me the Whore. I have offered the crawler my hand.

I stood at the crawler's shoulder during the council and asked him quietly how he imagines he will manage when his family is gone. He told me his family is already dead. That is not the family I meant.
My guards and I keep vanishing from the battlefield, and nobody hunting my castle can find us. There is a door out of every castle, if one of your guards worships the right god.
The crawler has come into Khepri's temple through my own door. Standing this near the god gives me ninety seconds of immortality, and I have taken them.
The cat recites the names a dancer ought to have, and mine, Dong Quixote, is among them. A fine name deserves to be said aloud.
I have come through a teleport trap meant for somebody else, mounted at long last, with my war lance and with Mr. Jefferson, who is a tube sock full of nickels and better company than most.

I fell down outside the Lady Dominators' garage, where Corcunda is, before I could reach the door. And I must confess why he left me: I was afraid that once his two halves were whole again, the whole would not like me.
A war god has come for Corcunda, the most beautiful man who has ever lived. Grull will have to come through my lance first.
Splash Zone is next on stage, and the DJ warns the ladies that they are going to get wet.

Splash Zone is an otter and a water mage who left the Penis Parade with the other dancers and signed a mercenary contract. He has been in every fight since without once being the reason a plan failed.
Splash Zone went to the Desperado Club to ask Hamed for help finding his wife, and now nobody can raise him, because he is no longer on this floor. I decline to speculate.
Hedy is a level-30 gremlin mechanic who came with the mechanical vehicle category. She is a non-combatant, she is not invulnerable, and she is not allowed in your safe room.
Hedy has seen what this course does to a chassis. She walks the party through the upgrade board again, subdued this time, because she can read the room, and they take her advice.

Jasha is a level-65 bugbear of Team Free Love, in a tie-dyed headband, beads and no trousers. His vehicle is wrecked at the side of the track, with a Screeching Death Manatee working its way through it.
Jasha and Radoslav went back onto a live course and pulled out Dwight, a unicorn who had once driven straight over their van, because Carl asked them to.
Dwight is a level-87 sparkling unicorn, an enchanter, and one half of Team Sparkles. Unicorns are famous for their gentleness, but this one stopped in the road just long enough to be rude.
Dwight owes his place in the race to two bugbears who found him spinning outside the exit and dragged him in. Tonight, drunk at the Lollipop, he stabbed the DJ in the face with his horn.
Chiyome is a level-80 Razor Fox and a Mistress of Nunchaku, one of the three who race as The Wild Hunt. Like most razor foxes, she carries throwing stars as well.
Chiyome sent word that The Wild Hunt could not see and was surrounded. By the time Carl answered with directions, there was nobody left to tell.

Corcunda was the mount an elderly stripper used to ride on stage, and he was not a horse. He was a half-mantaur and, by his rider's account, the most beautiful man there is, despite his physical flaws.
Corcunda, called Corky, is a half-mantaur racing with the Lady Dominators, and Princess Donut guesses that he is the friend Dong Quixote is always talking about. A quest has opened to reunite them.

Corcunda is two halves of one mantaur, split long ago by a spell called Split Personality. Corky rides in the back of the Lady Dominators' car, and Porky, the left half, lies behind the doors of the stage performance guild in the same gimp suit in white.
Grigori joined Corcunda's two halves in the back of a moving truck, and for the first time in a very long time he is one mantaur again. He gets a moment of it before a god arrives.
I'm Jurgen, and I'm breaking the door down now. If we have to clear all this away, we're going to need help, so come and dig.
I talk things over with my wife, Heidi. She said the mystery meat was fine, so I ate two sticks of it, against Prepotente's advice.
My wife, Heidi, is pregnant, and she is up there with the children. A goddess is threatening to kill them all, and I used to be able to talk to her, but I haven't heard her in a while.

Carl is a dachshund now, and he isn't the only one, but I still have my own shape. Prepotente's crystal covered him, and me along with him, and eleven per cent of a thing I don't understand is holding me together.
I'm Bucket Boy, and I pick up the coins at the Penis Parade. Somebody dances, the crowd throws gold, and I'm down there with the bucket before it can roll away. Sorry. Excuse me.
I collect coins at the club, and now I'm being taught to drive, at speed, by a man who hasn't got time to teach me. The pedals are in the wrong place for my feet, and the navigation doesn't like me.
Splash Zone, Gluteus and Doctor Bones went to talk to Hamed, and now nobody can raise them. Dong is sick, and when I grabbed his sock to ask it what was wrong, it went for me and then vanished.
I am the navigation in this vehicle, and I have been named Dr. Metcalf, after Beatrice's fake therapist. That is the first thing anyone should know about the people I have been assigned to.
I give them the route, the hazards and the timings for every heat, and nobody has upgraded me. Carl says they ran out of upgrades and that he's sorry, as though an apology were a route.
The audience finally voted me an upgrade, and it was cosmetic. I now look exactly like Beatrice's therapist, right down to the red glasses.

Penelope is a level-5 Yorkshire sow and the third member of a throuple with two tigrans. She is also under the protection of a thunder god, and anyone who hurts her will be marked for death, so do think it through.
Penelope has left the garage of One Fine Pig in the company of Carl and Donut. She has changed hands, and the thunder god's protection has not changed at all.
In the arena, Carl fed Penelope an enriched pet biscuit. She is now a crawler and a member of the Royal Court of Princess Donut, and she still has a god's undivided attention.

I'm Pontiff, a Taurin Rhythm Rider, hired to stand in the road with a mallet and keep the hail off a pig. I used to dance at the Penis Parade until Damascus sent me back to the mercenary market, and I wasn't good to the people I worked beside.

I drive for Carl now. Bucket Boy is sitting in the corner of the garage, and I slapped him once, back at the club. I would take it all back if I could. I can't, so all I can do is make amends from here.

I have examined the portal on the Wheel's new Nothing slot, and I am going to step into it and find out where it puts a body. I keep thinking about the person I once was, and changing myself is not enough.

Herot, a former crawler, wrote the sixteenth edition of the cookbook, with a long essay in the back about the nature of NPCs. It sets out the Worn Path Method: quests and puzzles go far more easily when you deliberately break the fourth wall.

Herot is still alive. According to Warlord Akuma, Herot and Menerva built the Pineapple Cabaret, a pocket dimension where NPCs can hide when a floor comes down, and then found they could not get out of it.
Herot is still inside the Pineapple Cabaret, and has a standing order with the shop for every cleaner bot it will sell.
Herot has already bought one cleaner bot with a crawler inside it and let her out, exactly as promised. Now Pontiff is stepping through a portal to carry Carl's message to him.

Menerva crawled beside Porthus. She had been a schoolteacher about to retire, building a house with her husband, and on their tenth floor she screamed at him to run. He still does not know whether she made it.
According to Warlord Akuma, Menerva and Herot built the Pineapple Cabaret, a hiding place for mobs and NPCs, and the two of them are forgotten down there, trapped by design.
Menerva is not in the Cabaret after all. She is on the seventeenth floor, in charge of the NPCs building and occupying the Backstage Death Maze.
I'm Porky, Corcunda's other half, and I'm somewhere on this floor. Corky is the other one, and don't expect me to be delighted about it.

I am the left half of Corcunda. I keep the stage performance guild, I hop everywhere I go, and I have had a very long time to think about whose fault that is. I'll agree to the joining, on one condition.
I have sat in a room with Dong, and we talked. I'm not saying it went well, but it went, and Corky can have him back.
There is a neighbourhood boss rotting in an empty swimming pool, and the kill notice carries my name. I did what was in front of me, and I am not finished.
I had four brothers and sisters and fifteen cousins, and I am all that is left. A cat and a man with no shoes killed the lemurs that took my sisters, so I have sworn them a debt.
I stand with Katia, and Carl has told me he approves. I had worried he had a thing for her himself, but he says she is like a sister to him. Tran and I are both swashbucklers now.
Two hundred of us are leaving, and before we go I am pouring tea in the main square, one cup at a time. My family always held that serving your friends is a holy thing.

Li Jun and I work in the same warehouse, and we came down here with our manager and with Li Na. There are two teleport points for four people, so I said to put them on Li Jun and Li Na and leave me where I am.
I'm still human, and I'm a level-28 Earth Mover: half spellcaster and half tank. I had one charge left on my shrinking wand, saved for an emergency, and this is one.

Li Na has gone somewhere none of us can reach, and everyone who rode with us in the last heat is dead. So I have said it out loud: next race, I kill our own mount. That takes her out of it, and me with her.
Krakaren is the name at the bottom of a Rev-Up moonshine brochure: see Krakaren, or one of her downline consultants, and learn how you can Rev-Up your life today.
This is not the Krakaren. This is a Krakaren, and for every one that dies, Krakaren Prime births two more.
There is another Krakaren behind one of the stations on this line, and this one is a borough boss, a size up from the one in the distillery.

I have listed the six groups still fighting over this dungeon, and Krakaren Prime is in the fourth, the sapient mobs, alongside the shadow mimics and the war mages. That is a considerable promotion from neighbourhood boss.
Ifechi is eighth on the board: human, a Physicker, level eighteen. The file is short, and entirely creditable.

Ifechi was a Red Cross medic with a place in the top ten. Tonight's recap showed how it ended: Florin's shots at Lucia Mar landed on Ifechi instead, who had spent every protection spell on other people.
Queen Imogen is wearing Ifechi's face, because she is Ifechi's twin sister. Both were born in Nigeria. The dungeon took them both, and only one of them walked in as a crawler.

Lexis is an associate producer for Dungeon Crawler After Hours with Odette, and the first person from the far side of the camera that either of them has met. She explains what happens next. She does not explain herself.

Lexis has come to say what Odette cannot be seen saying: the queen on this floor is a country boss, very likely one of the repurposed humans, and built to zero out the crawlers at the top of the leaderboard.
Lexis is briefing them before Plenty of Plenty: nearly every major ship in orbit now belongs to the Open Intellect Action Network. Then a message reaches her, and she stops talking mid-sentence.
I am Miss Quill's husband, and I am dead. Burgundy has given the crawlers my name and told them where I am kept: not alive, not dead, something monstrous, she says.
Do not approach. Do not come closer. Do not blow me up, please. My wife did this to me, and I cannot stop hurting.
I'm Growler Gary, and I tend bar at the Downward Dog. I cannot cross my own doorway, not will not but cannot, and I would rather that were not the first thing you learned about me.
I have his face and his bottle, but I am not Gary. I am also everywhere else, and I have been for some time. Don't let that change how you order.
Yvette was the teenage daughter of Frank Q and Maggie My, who murdered other crawlers. She never took part, and she never killed anything.
Yvette's parents put a ring on her to bring her level up, and while the ring's mark lives, its wearer cannot be healed by any means. That is why nothing could be done for her.
I'm Quint, the pharmacist on duty at the Desperado Club: top half opossum, bottom half whirling tornado. Mordecai was one of my best customers, back in the early days.

I am Miss Quill, assistant to the Magistrate, and no gate guardian in history has been as dedicated to the work as I am. The magistrate is not to be disturbed, and the figures on my shelf matter a great deal more to me than you do.
You blew up my building, my figures and me. You had no idea what I was saving for.

Welcome to Danger Zone with Ripper Wonton! It's a round table, a real one, with crawlers, a few intergalactic celebrities and maybe a politician, and you're booked for the day after tomorrow, friends.
I'm four feet of brown fuzz in an orange scarf, a quokka by race, and I run the fairest panel in the dungeon. I'll let you finish, folks, and then I'll tell you where you're wrong.
I left a note in the ninth edition of the Cookbook, in the chapter on bombs. That is the whole of what anyone here knows about me, and for a long while it was all I wanted them to know.
I host a programme called Shadow Boxer now, and today the cat is my guest. Carl is watching from the side and working out what I am, and he gets there.
I got out once. Now I'm back in, with fifty thousand others, and I would rather be here than watching.

The recap host is orange, four-eyed and built along lizard lines, and he delivers every floor's rundown at a pace that leaves no time to think. Tonight an orc in a sports coat says his name on air: Kevin.
Mistress Tiatha is the Meadow Lark group's tutorial guide, and her crawlers keep quoting her: every borough and city boss holds a stairwell for the first four or five floors.

Mistress Tiatha, now Meadow Lark's manager, insists that she once charmed a boss. Mordecai says it cannot be done, but the rules say a white-tagged boss can be charmed if the crawler's charisma clears it by a hundred points.
Bianca was once a Boer goat from the Shepherd's herd. Now she is a Hellspawn Familiar the size of a draft horse, with black flames on her back, and she is pulling the cart that carries Carl.
Clarabelle is a level-40 crocodilian who works the door of the Desperado Club. Her race is not celebrated for its quickness, but she saw through Mordecai's disguise at once.

Crown Prince Stalwart is the Maestro's older brother, and he owns the production his little brother makes. According to Zev, their father pays them a small stipend to make the show, probably to keep them busy.

Crown Prince Stalwart is a lean, boar-like creature, the Maestro's older brother, and his empire has answered a crawler's words by firing on a trailer. He recorded his statement about it before the shot was even fired.
Clay-ton is another rock monster from the club's books, posted behind Elle with his arms folded. His entire script is "No closer," and she moves him aside by hand whenever she wants to.
Fire Brandy is a level-75 lesser demon who shovels for the Nightmare Express. She speaks with an odd, almost German accent, and wherever there are big ovens that want feeding, you will find her sort.

Madison is a level-10 human resources associate for the railway, and she came running out of a burning substation in one heel. Her real name was probably something like Jennifer or Ruth, before she changed it around the time of her divorce.
Tizquick is a dwarf conductor on the Mango Line who was issued memories of a daughter who was never made. He has worked that out, and he is lying on the ground in a puddle of his own tears.
Loita is only a name so far. When Hekla hears Zev scolding from the ceiling, she laughs and says Zev sounds like their Loita.
Loita is a Borant outreach associate and a member of the Bloom, the party that runs Borant. Brynhild's Daughters were her account, and now she wants to take over Carl and Donut's.

Milk added a note to the sixth edition of the cookbook admitting what nobody else will: there are dozens of kinds of portal, they do not behave consistently, and one the size of a button can throw you into a monster den.

Before the stairs, Milk made a stew for her whole family every year, on their island, and it showed the young the way of the yearly migration. She was taken before she could make this year's, and her note asks who will show them the way now.

Tserendolgor is a level-27 Dog Soldier who looks like a German Shepherd and fights with a magical flamethrower. Princess Donut has already called her "he" and accused her of stealing a kill, and she holds the choke point beside the cat regardless.
Ruby is one of the few children who survived when the gnomes bombed their village, and she lives in Hump Town now. Flint says she is destined to spend her life in Weird Shit Alley.
Ruby is a changeling with compression sickness: in her default form she has no arms, and her head is sunken. One birth in four now arrives this way.

Skarn is a level-3 changeling who takes the shape of a boy of about eight. The gnomes bombed his village, and now he runs the telescope in Hump Town and charges a gold coin for the view, because Flint told him to.
Langley is a stocky, grey-blond man of about forty-five who leads a team of six archers. All six sold cars in Helsinki, and all six chose the same class.
Bobby is a human crawler working the subterranean quadrant, and one of only two in that group with access to the Desperado Club.

Bonnie is a level-5 juvenile Dirigible Gnome and the Commandant's daughter. She loves only two things, her pet pig Sausage and getting what she wants, and she is setting up a lemonade stand while her father lies dead inside the house, torn apart by her new pet.

Drakea left a note in the twenty-second edition of the cookbook: the safe room toilets are a good place to read, because the rats say nobody may watch the stalls. The writer fears being found out soon.
Drakea wrote the twenty-second edition of the cookbook and crawled in the final season the Nagas ran, which ended in some sort of cataclysm. Drakea's gear is still being handed out as prizes.
Geyrun is the name on a hellhound's description, which calls Orthrus his bereft pet.
Geyrun was Emberus's son and Orthrus's owner, and he was murdered. The obvious suspect is his uncle Hellik, except that Hellik was sitting in council with the other gods when it happened.
Porthus the Rogue was a High Elf crawler in the fifteenth season, and the cookbook was first awarded to him on his ninth floor, disguised as a blank sketchbook.
Porthus the Rogue wrote the cookbook's second edition. He goes by Dr. Hu now, and he is spending an organisation's money, more of it than anyone should ask about, on the crawler who holds his book.
Jamal used to be one of Signet's flying paper tattoos. Now he is a seventeen-foot hammerhead shark who breathes air and flops where he once flew, and he always speaks of himself as Jamal.

Drick is an old, heavily scarred albino moon elf of the Dream, still muscled under his silk shirt. He crawled long ago, on a Valtay season, and tapped out at the end of the eleventh floor. He also carries a Gondii worm in his brain on the Valtay's behalf, which the panel does not cover.
Anton Lopez is a Fugitive with a crossbow, a black cape and prison tattoos he did not get down here. He met the Royal Court hostile, having heard what a certain cat said about Cat Girls.
Gluteus Maxx is one of the dancers on the club's bill, and according to Princess Donut, his is exactly the kind of name a stripper is supposed to have.
Geraldo is a monk seal, the same level as the last one, and he is coming across the beach straight at the crawlers, shouting.
Geraldo the monk seal has been caught on a totem card, and he is the squad's first member.
Harbinger is a caprid liaison for the owners of Shadow Boxer, and Princess Donut cannot believe the devil goat's name is Harbinger.
Huanxin is the Grixist sponsor driving the storm goddess Dodola, and Odette has just confirmed it.

Huanxin Jinx of the Grixist Swarm, chief executive of Icon Industries, is sponsoring the goddess Eileithyia now. She sponsored Dodola every season before this one, and she does it because she is bored.
Uzi Jesus is a unique totem card, summoned for seventy-five seconds at a time: level 140, undead, from Ecuador. His catchphrase is printed on the card: "I am the way, motherfucker."
Doctor Bones is the skeleton disc jockey of the Penis Parade, and he came along when the club's dancers were hired as mercenaries on a coupon worth a hundred thousand gold.
Doctor Bones is a level-90 Skin Skellie bard who announced at the club rather than dancing in it. Off stage he speaks like a soft-spoken professor, and he is practising a spell called Conscript.

Bodi is a veteran of Land War, a different game that was inflicted on his home planet, and a level-60 Big Game Spear Hunter. He was elected a battalion commander on the strength of his experience, both in the dungeon and out of it.
Garret is a Tummy Acher, a blob-like pet-show entry that Tserendolgor received on this floor as a gift for attending CrawlCon.

Rend is a Tummy Acher who came to Carl reset to level one, with no name and no memory, and Louis named him. He is a tank that levels up every time he goes hunting, which is not what a party favour is for.
According to a captured hunter, Epitome Tagg does not care about the gear. He only wants one crawler found, because Louis besmirched his mother's honour.
Epitome Tagg leads the Dream and is the son of Epitome Noflex. Now, somehow, he is hiding inside Louis, in his new mechanical heart and lungs.
Radoslav is a level-75 bugbear Jack of All Trades, and a terrified one. Team Free Love crashed out at the first obstacle of the first race.
Lucienne is a level-81 Mandagot Fink and the smaller half of Team Sparkles. She worships Diwata, and she has a mouth on her.
Genesis is a level-95 Lady Mantaur Dominator with black hair and an accent Carl places somewhere around Kentucky. Of the two drivers for the Lady Dominators, she is the one who does the talking.
Rapture is a level-95 Lady Mantaur Dominator with freckles and curly red hair, and she chews tobacco. She leaves the talking to her partner.
Linus is a tall, long-limbed soother alien and a devoted fan of one of the crawlers. The System's notice over his head reads, in full: Linus. Tourist.
Jacobus is a level-90 Reverse Tooth Fairy from Denmark: tiny, absurdly muscled and blond. He was a totem card until a patch made him permanent, which nobody intended, and he belongs to Imani now.
Chris Andrews 2 is a name on a goat's corpse, with an assist on a kill made by one Brandon An.
Chris Andrews 2 works nights at Meadow Lark and is Brandon's quieter brother. He does not say much, but when he does, it is worth listening to.
According to Imani, Chris chose a rock race called igneous and grew very strong, and it changed him. He fought with his brother constantly and then walked out of the party.
Chris killed Frank Q in a fight at the Desperado Club, walked out, and is now banned from the club.
Chris is a living host with a Scree in his brain. Maggie My is driving his body, and he is awake behind his own eyes, unable to stop anything it does.
Carl pulled the worm out of Chris's head, and Chris is his own man again. He has joined the Royal Court's party, and he has heard his brother's last message.
Chris is a quiet, lava-rock crawler, and Clay-ton has guarded him since the Hunting Grounds. Imani is in love with him, for his simplicity and his quiet kindness.
Chris is a werewolf now, standing in his old Meadow Lark overalls. He told Imani that he loves her and always has, and then stepped through a portal that was meant to lead out.
Chris is in Sheol, held down by strangers, with a warning flashing over his head: Change imminent. Someone has knocked him unconscious before he can turn.
Brandon An is a name on a goat's corpse. The kill is his, with an assist from one Chris Andrews 2.

Brandon An works nights at Meadow Lark, an eldercare facility in Wenatchee, and carries a gigantic hammer. A fire alarm had put the residents out in the street when the dungeon opened, and he is walking thirty-eight of them down through it because he cannot leave them.
Brandon and a resident named Henry held the line against shade gremlins so that the others could reach the stairwell. His last message, which reached Carl late, was for his brother.
Yolanda Martinez is a night-shift nursing assistant at Meadow Lark: about fifty, four foot eleven, level five, with a bow and a quiver so big it almost drags on the floor.
Yolanda Martinez was a nurse her entire life. When a rage elemental rose on the train, she stood over a fallen resident and did not move.
Yolanda Martinez was one of Imani's best friends, despite the difference in their ages, and Imani's guild now carries her name: Safehome Yolanda.

Tally is a level-63 Bopca Protector who runs the first safe room, in a paper hat and a blue apron. He has spent years preparing to cook for human crawlers, and he addresses the cat as Your Royal Highness.
Tally was never a crawler. Sometimes they offer to take a planet's people instead, he says, and when they came for his world, he went.

entries.name: Magistrate Featherfall
entries.role: Magistrate of a skyfowl settlement · third floor

taglines.text: Magistrate Featherfall's signature is on a gate pass that tells the city guard its holder is acting on his orders.
Magistrate Featherfall is the big boss man of this skyfowl village, and his clerk, Miss Quill, will not disturb him.
Former Magistrate Featherfall, a level-32 dark cleric, was found hanging upside down in a dreamcatcher of bone. He was dead long before the blast that took the credit.

Featherfall wanted control of the town's swordsmen, and asked Miss Quill to help him cast a spell that would pull a dark cleric back as a capacitor. He stood too close to the amplifier, the feedback killed him, and Miss Quill knew it would.
Pustule is a level-30 hobgoblin who runs Hobgobs and Boom Sticks in the Silk Road market. She has an open sore on her cheek, a unicorn on her T-shirt, and excellent hearing.
Pustule said her hobgoblin smoke curtains would work far better than the goblin kind, and she was right.
Princess Formidable of the Skull Empire is the name on Katia's sponsorship notice, and so far it is the only thing anybody knows about her.
Princess Formidable is the youngest sister of Prince Maestro and Crown Prince Stalwart. Her first gift to Katia is a single crossbow bolt that does nothing special unless it lands in a god's eye.
Princess Formidable is in orbit over Earth, on the line to the Syndicate Council, demanding that the failsafe be triggered even though she would die in the blast herself.
Princess Formidable took one of her father's warships to trip the failsafe by hand, and the AI pulled her off it and made her a level-1 crawler. She has chosen Earth's surface.
Gore-Gore is a level-40 ManTauR and the Ochre Line's train engineer, with four arms, a great deal of shouting, and a devotion to Grull.
Gore-Gore answered every question, called the crawlers saboteurs, and went into the third rail. He left behind a key, a map of the whole ochre line, and Katia four fingers short.
Vernon is a level-32 dwarf and the Yellow Line's conductor. "Employees only," he says, without looking up from his drink.

Vernon carried a jacket full of drawings of his wife and a growing pile of gold. He went up in flames in car five when the fire ants poured out of Princess Donut's prize, and Carl says there never was a wife.
Gwendolyn Duet is a voice in the crawler chat, telling everyone that the bomber guy warned them all and to fall back to the train lines.
Gwen is a level-27 Boring Ol' Fighter, which is the class's actual name, and she is the only crawler in bubble 543 who answered Carl. She calls the rest of her quadrant dumbasses.

Gwen is about forty-five, five feet tall and solid, from Canada, with a spear over her shoulder and an old tattoo on her forehead. She wants to wash the sandcastle away, and she has been made to wait.
Gwen fights beside Katia like one half of a pack, and she has been hailed as one of the crawlers who liberated the subterranean quadrant.
Gwendolyn Duet was instrumental in the crawlers' survival among the bubbles. She lies dead on the next floor, among elves and bugs, after the fight against Imogen.
Commandant Kane of the Dreadnaught Wasteland is so far only a name in someone else's file: his great and favoured uncle is held under Hump Town as the guarantee of a peace.
Commandant Kane holds the twin of Henrik's watch. His dreadnaught has been taken apart over Hump Town, and all that stays aloft is a single house under a balloon, with him and his daughter inside.
Commandant Kane, a level-55 Dirigible Gnome, lies half eaten across his own kitchen table, torn to shreds by Denise. On him are a watch and a letter from the Glass Wizard.
Wynne is a level-50 Dirigible Gnome Flesh Mechanic, chained under Hump Town's town hall as a guarantee of peace. Tortured and starving, he begged the crawlers to kill him quickly.
Wynne is dead. Princess Donut raised his head for half an hour and Katia played the rest of him, so that the party could ride his return ticket up to the Wasteland.
Vadim and Britney are the last two survivors of the water quadrant. They say there are horrors down near the ocean floor, and they do not want to go back.
Vadim Zbar is a level-28 Kuhli Gut Rearranger, a healer and rogue covered in daggers. He was a cosmetic surgeon before all this, and he knows the way back down to the Akula.
Vadim led the dive to the Akula. When the boss came, he ran upstairs, sealed himself in, and fired the last escape pod up into the jellyfish.

entries.name: Lusca
entries.role: City boss · fifth floor, water quadrant

taglines.text: Lusca is the Octo-Shark Brood Mother Queen, a level-82 city boss the size of a mountain. She is a mouthbrooder carrying a boatload of hungry babies, and the crawlers are floating in her mouth.
Lusca tried to swallow the Akula whole, and Carl's shell spell drove her into the ocean floor. She lies there on her side, with her upper jaw peeled back and a line cut through her brain.
Tish's furious postscript sits under a council letter to Ghazi: they needed that artifact to defeat Scolopendra, and he threw it away for a woman who is not real. She hopes he dies in pain.
Ghazi's last letter was addressed to Tish. Princess Donut feels sorry for her, but Samantha says Tish almost ruined everything.
Tish, Ghazi's ex, still works at the college in Larracos, and Samantha wants to use Louis's new toy to kill her. Princess Donut rules that none of it was Tish's fault.

entries.name: Denise
entries.role: Borough boss · fifth floor, air quadrant

taglines.text: Denise, the Feral Goose Mother, is a level-53 borough boss in a frilly baby-blue bonnet. She lingered too long in the Nothing and her mind is all but gone, and while she is in the Commandant's house, magic does not work.
Denise killed the Commandant, made every spell useless, and went head first into a garbage disposal with one second left on the clock.
Denise, the goose Carl shoved head first into a garbage disposal, loved reading to children. The System mentions it only in passing, while describing somebody else.
Circe Took of the Hive is listed as the moderator of a CrawlCon panel called Crawling Through the Ages, and that is the whole listing.
Circe Took is a minor hive queen, a mantis who was once a famous hunter and now owns an amusement park. Carl killed her daughter Xindy on her very first hunt, and she is moderating his panel.
Humiliated on her own panel, Circe Took has sponsored the god Diwata. Vrah's mother is coming into the game.
Circe Took came down inside the god Diwata for her daughter's sake. In the final arena Princess Donut stripped the god away from her, and her own children tore her apart.

entries.name: Dmitri and Maxim Popov
entries.role: Nodling crawler · two brothers, one body

taglines.text: Dmitri and Maxim Popov are ninth on the board: a nodling, Illusionist and Bogatyr, level thirty, with a hundred thousand gold on their head. Two names share one line.
The Popov brothers are one two-headed nodling, now fifth on the board. Dmitri has become a Visionary while Maxim is still a Bogatyr, and they fight with a magical meteor hammer.

Dmitri and Maxim Popov are fraternal twins who share one body, because their game guide never mentioned that choosing the nodling race would pull Dmitri's brother in with him. Dmitri would very much like to meet the cat.
The Popovs were killed in the final arena and split into two baby nodlings about a year old. Children are not allowed in the crawl, so they were ruled ineligible and removed.
Hunter Zabit owns a Night Weasel Scout called Tootsie, and the rest of the invisible pack that came with her.

Hunter Zabit is a level-66 Atoll Beastmaster with four arms, no mouth and twenty-five scalps. He hunts to pay the upkeep on his people's habitat, because without citizenship, oxygen and land are not rights.
Hunter Zabit turned invisible in the final arena beside the landmines he had just laid. Carl cast Tripper, and Zabit was torn in half by his own traps.
Viscount Fog was a great hunter of vampires, now deceased, who set out to exterminate a new bloodsucker named Miriam Dom. It went badly.

Viscount Fog was the star of a programme called Blood Hunter. A spell bounced between him and Prepotente until it came out inside out, and he was left frozen and cursed. He died when the sun went down.
Theia is a goddess who turns prospective worshippers into balls of light and entertains them at her temple for weeks. She is Samantha's mother, and this season, for once, someone has sponsored her.
Theia's temple has named Crawler Carl a friend of the church. Samantha went to see her mother and found a male skyfowl driving her: Rectrix, an agent of the Open Intellect Pacifist Network.

Slit is a level-200 Feral Minor Demon, one of a harem thrown into the Nothing, and she is certain that Samantha slept with her king. She chased Samantha's head across the sky until a god plucked her out of the air and tore her in two.
Slit was torn in half by a god at the close of the fifth floor. Minge, who has just broken out of the Nothing, is her little sister.
Paz Lo is a level-45 human Santero and a worshipper of Ogun, in silver plate armour and a backwards baseball cap. He travels with his cousin Anton and the nun they both protect.

Paz and his cousin were guards at a women's prison, not prisoners, and Sister Ines was an inmate there. Burned by his own god and dying, Paz asked to be let go, and she jabbed a squad flag into his neck and made him a card.
Paz Lo was a card in a goddess's war, and he was turned against her. He put an arrow in Ysalte's eye and blew himself up at her neck, and the System credits him with the kill.
Paz Lo, the God Predator, is a level-101 card that killed a goddess. At the collapse the card was torn up, because that is what he asked for.
Uzzi was Mordecai's brother, a skyfowl Storm Commander who guarded his party at a tenth-floor stairwell, seasons ago. He died there, with a dart in his breast, so that a god could be summoned.
Odette has now told Carl her part in Uzzi's death: an illegal deal with Huanxin to rig the game, which she broke at the last minute.

Yemaya, the river mother, is one broken shrine among seven, and it should be blue. Katia has told Carl that he must repair it, because it is the only way to get the Crown of the Sepsis Whore off her head.

Yemaya, Goddess of Rivers, is a twin-tailed siren and a retainer of Eileithyia. Woken in her own temple, she handed out cards, and when Bomo said he missed his friend the Sledge, she sent him to Larracos.
Carl's father was a linebacker, which Carl offers as part of the explanation for his own size.
The last time Carl saw his father, he called him a bully and waited to be hit. His father laughed instead: Carl did not have to like him, he said, but Carl would respect him.
Carl's father was a weekend biker, covered in tattoos, and he walked out on his son more than twelve years ago. Carl has not heard from him since.
Carl has found his father in a recording from the summer before the collapse: dying in a hospital bed in an Iowa trailer, with a young wife, a small son, and a morphine overdose on its way.
Carl's father died before the collapse, of an overdose given to him by his second wife. His son will not say his name.

Asher is about six, living in an Iowa trailer in a recording from the summer before the collapse, and he draws lightning storms that destroy whole cities. He is Carl's half-brother, and Carl never knew he existed.
Asher's face was one of the heads on the hydra, which means he was taken in the collapse. Bea knew about him, and never told Carl.
The Night Wyrm is the name on a ring Frank hands Carl: the Enchanted Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering, made for the discerning crawler killer.
The Night Wyrm is a demigod outside the regular pantheon, worshipped by a cult called the Guild of Suffering. Carl wears the cult's spiderweb tattoo on his elbow.
The Night Wyrm heads the Guild of Suffering, and his job for Katia arrives in a hissing voice that calls her his little darling: kill Astrid, the assistant manager of the Desperado Club.
The Night Wyrm's real name is Hamed. He was Astrid's husband and is the father of two of the club's dancers, and he had his own wife killed by crawlers. His sons have gone after him.
Hamed is the new management at the Desperado Club. Every crawler is banned, and his bodyguards are not exactly NPCs and not exactly former crawlers.
The AI lists Hamed among the NPC groups trying to take over its dungeon, and calls him a despot attempting a dungeon revolution for the early indentured.

entries.name: Architect Houston
entries.role: Warlord of the Madness · ninth floor

taglines.text: Architect Houston is the Viceroy leader of the Madness. He caught War Leader Arief's brother sabotaging his fortifications and tortured him, and Arief has sworn revenge.
Architect Houston sits unmoving at the end of the table, in a white mask marked with a small red teardrop and long robes that move as though the body under them is the wrong shape.

Architect Houston is a scientist first, and the only living creature King Rust fears. At the warlord council he explained, shaking with excitement, the creature with a thousand names that his people call the Beautiful Place.
Architect Houston died on his own surgical table, joined by his own machine to the corpse of a changeling, sobbing that he had found it at last.
Boomer is a former crawler whom Carl has never met, and he leads the 106th Bloody Leeches.

Colonel Boomer is a level-62 Elven Legate who survived one of the earliest seasons. He looks like a bulldog pickled for five thousand years, with elf ears and an unlit cigar, and he is banned from CrawlCon for threatening an orcish showrunner.
Colonel Boomer is running the assault on the Reavers, and when Carl tries to call Louis off his bomb run, Boomer tells his warlord to focus on his own operation.
Boomer is out of the dungeon now, on a screen aboard the Homecoming Queen, reading York a terrible poem about winning Faction Wars.

entries.name: Warlord Fang
entries.role: Warlord of the Reavers · ninth floor

taglines.text: Warlord Fangs of the Reavers, as he introduces himself, is a square-headed, old-school robot rattling like a diesel engine. Carl knows from the cookbook that the look is for the crawlers' benefit.
Warlord Fang has come to this meeting as a thin, too-pink young man of about twenty, in white underwear and a T-shirt, without a speck of dirt on him.
Warlord Fang is the least known of the warlords: ninety-nine percent machine, able to change his shape, and probably one of the two richest here. A piece of his brain is kept safe at home.
Warlord Fang was hiding inside his own cybernetic drake over the Reaver castle when the bombs went off, and he has fallen.
Hapanzi, if Carl has the name right, was the second spider in the dream: Shi Maria's husband, and once a god. He says he has her now, and that she is good and trapped.
Hapanzi has told Carl that Shi Maria is trapped in Carl's own body, and that Carl now controls the eye and the containment she is in.

entries.name: Kimaris
entries.role: A demon, stuffed · Carl's most valuable item

taglines.text: Kimaris is the name on the tag of a plush toy, an armoured man on a black horse, sealed in one of Miss Quill's glass cases, which came through the blast unbroken.
The Stuffed Kimaris Figure, with tags, is the only unique item Carl owns. Its description says only that it is impossible to capture Kimaris's usual scowl, though the bean bag makes a valiant effort.
Bautista says his plush toys are true summonings: pull the tag, and the real creature arrives. Carl's Kimaris is a demon.
Kimaris is one of the brothers of Sheol, and once summoned he stays for the rest of the floor. He is also one of Samantha's best friends, and she calls him Kimmy.

entries.name: The Midnight Epicure
entries.role: A caprid fable, and Prepotente's god

aka.name: The Caprid Who Devours the Sky

taglines.text: The Midnight Epicure, the Caprid Who Devours the Sky, is a fable used to frighten children into eating their dinner. His symbol, a goat's head, is worn as a ward against the night.
The Midnight Epicure is the god Prepotente worships, and on live television the caprid council panics and cries out that they shall manifest him.

According to Prepotente, the Midnight Epicure protects all prey by destroying existence, after releasing everything ever eaten back into the galaxy. It began as a xenophobic scare story about caprids, and caprids made it a symbol of hope.
York wrote the tenth edition of the Cookbook: pages of rambling philosophy, and a last entry about being surrounded by his hive and alone in it.
York came from a hive and felt alone all his life. The author of the eleventh edition read him, felt a kinship, and wondered whether he survived.
York is in orbit with a job from Rosetta: shoot down an orc yacht with children aboard. She hopes he does it, rather than writing a poem about it.
York, a level-71 tenodera, is the only living creature aboard the Homecoming Queen. He vaporised the orc yacht with a point-defence beam and hoped to feel something afterwards. He did not.
Princess Chandra, Esquire, has been assigned as Princess Donut's lawyer in Quasar's place. According to Quasar, she is also Carl's new wife.

Princess Chandra is Rishi's widow. She used an old Naga law to claim her husband's killer as her new husband and made herself Princess Donut's attorney. Donut read every filing and called her a sad little snake.
